text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px inner glow at 20% opacity. This keeps the ring visible on patterned backgrounds without adding distracting glow. The trade-off is slightly less crisp edges, but the glow improves visibility for users with low contrast sensitivity.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring with inner glow still risks disappearing on patterned backgrounds. A 3px solid ring at #004499 with 4.5:1 contrast against white backgrounds would guarantee visibility for all users. Settle it with a live contrast test on the most complex background in the design system.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 3px solid #004499 focus ring with 4.5:1 contrast against white backgrounds. This guarantees visibility for users with low contrast sensitivity and patterned backgrounds, meeting WCAG 2.1 AA standards. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring, but it eliminates the risk of invisibility on complex designs. Test it live on the most complex background to confirm.

name: Reader
text: A 3px ring risks looking like a border, not a focus indicator, and may confuse users who expect a thin, precise highlight. Instead, keep the 2px ring but test it against the most complex background in the design system—if it fails, add a subtle 1px outer stroke at 50% opacity to boost contrast without bulk. Settle it with a live contrast test and user feedback on focus visibility.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt a 2.5px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 15% opacity glow at 2px offset—deliver a live contrast test on the most complex background in the design system by Friday, owned by Ramp.
